completed a PET scan with the high-affinity dopamine D2/3 receptor tracer [18F]fallypride

output.summary: Twenty-five healthy young adults completed a delay discounting task during fMRI and, on a separate visit, a PET scan with the [18F]fallypride D2/3 tracer; raw and BPND parametric PET images provided.
